verdict.rationale: Patent Center notes that direct API callers to Workbench/view applications had to change 'the version level of the APIs', which shows the APIs are versioned and that version changes are announced. A real API-key-gated endpoint exists at api.uspto.gov. However, no documented deprecation policy appears, and the developer portal docs are not readable without JavaScript, so the policy cannot be verified. Missing for 10: a published API deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices), a documented versioning scheme, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
